name: net.unfret/mcp
title: Unfret
description: Check a store or product page for scam, dropshipping and dark-pattern signals, paid per check

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_KEYPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Path to the agent's Solana CLI keypair JSON, the wallet that pays for checks (or set UNFRET_MCP_SECRET_KEY)

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single check worth more than this many dollars

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_SESSION_CAP_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse once the session has spent this many dollars

environmentVariables.name: UNFRET_MCP_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: solana-mainnet, or solana-devnet together with UNFRET_API_URL=https://dev.unfret.net
